title: This Desert Cat Goes Months Without Drinking, Even at 115 Degrees

scenes.text: This cat lives in a desert and can go months without a drink.
It's the sand cat, and it weighs only a few pounds.
It gets most of its water from the animals it eats.
Fur on its footpads shields it from scorching sand, and its wide paws leave barely a trace.
Huge ears hear prey moving under the sand, and they help release body heat.
Summer days over 115 degrees Fahrenheit, winter nights near minus 25. This tiny cat handles both.
